contract.timing: same-host system_monotonic; client logical call includes retries
contract.io: cgroup block service bytes are not application/filesystem bytes
contract.network: process network namespace interface counters are shared scope; not PID, HTTP payload, or TLS-inclusive bytes
contract.disk_footprint: explicit host-output and task-container directory boundaries use apparent file sizes; shared caches remain unavailable; ToolSandbox scenario state is in-memory
contract.missing: null plus reason; observed zero is preserved

semantic_spans.scope: saved events; must also compare expected runtime/trajectory counts

tool_spans.scope: saved events; must also compare expected runtime/trajectory counts

resource_sampling.scope: shared container; optional I/O availability reported separately

collector.note: read wall cost only; not CPU or full instrumentation overhead
